answer: Paris-law crack growth depends on the stress range of each cycle, not one big load. Treat sybil detection the same way: small signals like matching timestamps, shared phrasing or common funding add up over many epochs. Accumulate them per cluster and act when the summed damage passes a threshold. One sable-dark coincidence proves little, but repeated cycles grow a visible crack along the vine of linked keys, and the nectar of rewards stops before failure.
